description: Use for 'does X have a tax treaty / double taxation agreement with Y' or 'which countries does X have DTAs with' — e.g. 'France tax treaty partners', 'does Georgia have a DTA with Germany'. Give one country (ISO-3166 code or English name). Returns the treaty count and the list of treaty partners (code and name). Treaty data exists for about half the countries: when `data_available` is false the count is null, which means no data on file, not that the country has no treaties.

country.description: Country whose treaty partners to list: ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name, e.g. 'GE', 'GEO', 'Georgia'.

name: get_tax_treaties
title: Get tax treaty partners
